seo.title: Agadir Marina | Yacht Basin, Cafés & Evening Stroll | MoroccoTripMap
seo.description: Agadir Marina: yacht basin, waterfront cafés and an easy evening walk between the beach and the port.
seo.keywords: Agadir Marina, Agadir harbour, marina restaurants Agadir, yacht basin

overview.title: Marina life on the Atlantic
overview.p1: Agadir Marina gathers yachts, restaurants and a paved promenade at the northern curve of the bay. It is a contrast to the open beach: more structured, good for an evening stroll and seafood with a view of the masts.
overview.p2: By day it is quieter; after sunset the terraces fill. The marina links naturally with the corniche walk toward the main beach hotels.

s5.caption: View from the marina toward the bay

food.title: Eat at the marina
food.p1: This is one of the easiest places in Agadir for a sit-down seafood meal with a view — compare a few terraces before sitting down.
food.li2: Cafés for drinks without a full meal.
food.li3: Ice cream and snacks for a short stop.
food.li5: Book ahead in peak season evenings.

1.title: Access
1.desc: Walk from the northern beach or take a short taxi. Parking exists for those with a car.

2.title: Timing
2.desc: Late afternoon and evening for the best atmosphere.

3.title: Budget
3.desc: Marina restaurants are pricier than souk grills — check menus before ordering.

q1.question: Is the marina free to visit?
q1.answer: Yes — walking the promenade is free. Restaurants and cafés are paid.

q2.question: Is it good for families?
q2.answer: Yes — flat paths and open views. Keep children away from the water edge.

q3.question: Distance from the main beach?
q3.answer: At the northern end of the main beach strip — walkable from many hotels.

q4.question: Best for dinner?
q4.answer: Yes — popular for evening seafood. Arrive early or reserve in high season.

q5.question: Is it the fishing port?
q5.answer: No — the marina is the yacht and leisure basin. The working fishing port sits nearby but is separate.
